verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.cekura.ai and markdown versions of doc pages that point agents to that index. An OpenAPI spec is also served. First-party docs add an agent-integration guide for Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code Copilot, plus installable agent skills. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content export.
